question_text: The Commission on Audit (COA) is one of the three constitutional commissions. Which of the following best describes the constitutional guarantee of fiscal autonomy for the COA?

options.text: The COA's appropriations cannot be reduced by Congress below the amount appropriated for the previous year.
The COA has the power to levy taxes to fund its operations.
The COA's budget is automatically approved without need for congressional action.
The COA can borrow funds from foreign institutions without government approval.
